newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish troops kill 22 Kurdish rebels.
newsitem.headline: Turkish troops kill 22 Kurdish rebels.

text.p: Turkish government troops killed 22 Kurdish rebels fighting for self-rule in southeast Turkey, security officials said on Wednesday.
The emergency rule governor's office in Diyarbakir said in a statement that troops killed the guerrillas of the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) in separate clashes in seven southeastern provinces.

Turkish troops stepped up operations against the PKK in southeast to counter rebel infiltrations from northern Iraq after an Iraqi Kurdish faction allied with Baghdad late last month to conquer most of the Iraqi Kurdish region.
More than 20,000 people have been killed in the 12-year-old fight between the Turkish army and the PKK, which is fighting for independence or autonomy in southeast Turkey.
